question: Who took oath as Chief Minister for the second time and the first to assume office after the scrapping of Article 370 in Jammu and Kashmir?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Shri Manoj Sinha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shri Manoj Sinha** assumed office as the **Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir** following the scrapping of **Article 370**.
 
• He became the **second Chief Minister-level leader** to hold office after the abrogation of Article 370, marking a significant transition in the region
